notes.title: Garden Finish Update
notes.notes:
The Garden is finally complete! Enjoy the Update!

Detailed Patchnotes:

Features:

* New Ghost difficulty setting
* Being able to open and close doors
* Graphics Setting
* Toggle Sneak Setting
* Gamma Setting
* 3 new kill-cinematics
* A lot of new sounds
* A lot more decoration of the map
* 3 new Steam-Achievements
* Performance boost
* Reduced File storage

Bugfixes & Changes:

* Opening Settings in Tutorial bugged fixed
* Items still falling through floor fixed
* Tip-system not working properly fixed
* Dead dog blocking important things fixed
* Monster gets stuck on dog fixed
* Fireextinguisher reworked
* Tips being to apparent reworked
* No more random scare sound
* New design when holding gun or fireextunguisher
* Powercases now hidden when not in insane

notes.title: Small Update 1.1
notes.notes:
I reworked the tutorial and gave the player way more information on what to do

Detailed Patchnotes:

Features:

* Tutorial Rework
* Better Rendering of the levels
* FPS-Cap
* Settings Menu now working in Main Menu
* Back Button in Level Selection Menu
* In Inventory show more information on inputs
* Action Menu design
* New jumpscare sound
* Hunting mode sound
* UI rework
* Beeing able to break branches
* Tip system
* Indicator on how many lives are left
* Playtesters now in the credits

notes.title: Small Update 1.0
notes.notes:
In this update a lot of things were changed

Detailed Patchnotes:

Features:
* Steam achievements now working in the game
* Credits button
* Added more info to some story elements

Bugfixes
* Dog collision beeing to big fixed
* Fire slowly fading out
* Monster still catching you after escaping fixed
* Timer beeing to annoying fixed
* Branch in front of start to annoying
* Generator message when repaired
* Added a delay to whistle
* Fixed paper and screwdriver sometimes clipping through floor
* Fixed some scene components flying
* Fixed health not going down instantly

notes.title: Hotfix 1.0
notes.notes:
Fixed a gamebreaking bug, that froze the entire game.
Bug is now fixed, but game no longer pauses.

Let me know if you find any other issues.
